id.description: Publisher slug (for example iheartpodcasts, bbc-radio-4) or id, as carried on a podcast record's publisher.

tier.description: Only these tiers, comma-separated to match any, for example UNSAFE,SENSITIVE.

category.description:
Only shows exposed in this category.

Provider reference: allowed values ["adult_sexual", "arms_ammunition", "crime_harmful_acts", "death_injury_military_conflict", "online_piracy", "hate_speech_aggression", "obscenity_profanity", "illegal_drugs_alcohol_tobacco", "spam_harmful", "terrorism", "debated_social_issues", "misinformation"].

min_prevalence.description:
With category: only count exposure at or above this prevalence. INCIDENTAL is any non-NONE prevalence.

Provider reference: allowed values ["INCIDENTAL", "OCCASIONAL", "FREQUENT", "PERVASIVE"]; default "INCIDENTAL".

treatment.description:
With category: only count exposure whose treatment equals this value.

Provider reference: allowed values ["DOCUMENTARY", "EDITORIAL", "PROMOTIONAL", "GLAMORIZING"].

sort.description:
risk_desc puts the riskiest first, risk_asc the safest, recently_evaluated the newest assessment.

Provider reference: allowed values ["risk_desc", "risk_asc", "recently_evaluated"]; default "risk_desc".

limit.description:
Maximum records to return.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 25.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page. Omit for the first page; send the same filters with it.
